raw_sql:
SELECT supplier_id, COUNT(*) AS purchase_order_count
FROM purchase_orders
WHERE ordered_on >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND ordered_on < DATE '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY supplier_id;
reference_a: SELECT s.supplier_id, COUNT(p.po_id) AS june_orders FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.supplier_id=s.supplier_id AND p.ordered_on >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND p.ordered_on < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY s.supplier_id ORDER BY s.supplier_id
reference_b: SELECT s.supplier_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders p WHERE p.supplier_id=s.supplier_id AND p.ordered_on >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND p.ordered_on < DATE '2026-07-01') AS june_orders FROM suppliers s ORDER BY s.supplier_id

raw_sql:
SELECT pl.line_id, SUM(r.received_qty)::numeric / NULLIF(pl.ordered_qty, 0) AS fulfillment_rate
FROM po_lines AS pl
LEFT JOIN receipts AS r ON r.line_id = pl.line_id
GROUP BY pl.line_id, pl.ordered_qty
reference_a: SELECT l.line_id, COALESCE(SUM(r.received_qty),0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(l.ordered_qty,0) AS fulfillment_rate FROM po_lines l LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.line_id=l.line_id GROUP BY l.line_id,l.ordered_qty ORDER BY l.line_id
reference_b: SELECT line_id, COALESCE(received_qty,0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(ordered_qty,0) AS fulfillment_rate FROM (SELECT l.line_id,l.ordered_qty,SUM(r.received_qty) AS received_qty FROM po_lines l LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.line_id=l.line_id GROUP BY l.line_id,l.ordered_qty) q ORDER BY line_id

raw_sql:
SELECT pl.line_id, MAX(r.received_on) AS latest_receipt_timestamp
FROM po_lines AS pl
LEFT JOIN receipts AS r ON r.line_id = pl.line_id
GROUP BY pl.line_id
reference_a: SELECT DISTINCT ON (line_id) line_id, received_on AS latest_received_on FROM receipts ORDER BY line_id, received_on DESC, receipt_id DESC
reference_b: SELECT line_id, received_on AS latest_received_on FROM (SELECT line_id,received_on,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY line_id ORDER BY received_on DESC,receipt_id DESC) AS rn FROM receipts) q WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY line_id

raw_sql:
SELECT s.supplier_id, COALESCE(SUM(r.received_qty), 0) AS total_received_units
FROM suppliers AS s
LEFT JOIN purchase_orders AS po ON po.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
LEFT JOIN po_lines AS pl ON pl.po_id = po.po_id
LEFT JOIN receipts AS r ON r.line_id = pl.line_id
GROUP BY s.supplier_id
reference_a: SELECT s.supplier_id, COALESCE(SUM(r.received_qty),0) AS received_units FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.supplier_id=s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN po_lines l ON l.po_id=p.po_id LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.line_id=l.line_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id ORDER BY s.supplier_id
reference_b: SELECT s.supplier_id, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.received_qty) FROM purchase_orders p JOIN po_lines l ON l.po_id=p.po_id JOIN receipts r ON r.line_id=l.line_id WHERE p.supplier_id=s.supplier_id),0) AS received_units FROM suppliers s ORDER BY s.supplier_id

raw_sql:
SELECT p.product, COUNT(c.claim_id) AS claim_count
FROM policies AS p
JOIN claims AS c ON c.policy_id = p.policy_id
WHERE c.opened_on >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND c.opened_on < DATE '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY p.product;
reference_a: SELECT p.product,COUNT(c.claim_id) AS june_claims FROM policies p LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.policy_id=p.policy_id AND c.opened_on>=DATE '2026-06-01' AND c.opened_on<DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY p.product ORDER BY p.product
reference_b: SELECT p.product,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims c JOIN policies p2 ON p2.policy_id=c.policy_id WHERE p2.product=p.product AND c.opened_on>=DATE '2026-06-01' AND c.opened_on<DATE '2026-07-01') AS june_claims FROM policies p GROUP BY p.product ORDER BY p.product

raw_sql:
SELECT ph.region, SUM(c.loss_amount) AS total_reported_loss
FROM claims AS c
JOIN policies AS p ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id
JOIN policyholders AS ph ON ph.holder_id = p.holder_id
WHERE c.claim_status = 'open'
GROUP BY ph.region
reference_a: SELECT h.region,SUM(c.loss_amount) AS open_loss FROM policyholders h JOIN policies p ON p.holder_id=h.holder_id JOIN claims c ON c.policy_id=p.policy_id WHERE c.claim_status='open' GROUP BY h.region ORDER BY h.region
reference_b: SELECT region,open_loss FROM (SELECT h.region,SUM(c.loss_amount) AS open_loss FROM claims c JOIN policies p ON p.policy_id=c.policy_id JOIN policyholders h ON h.holder_id=p.holder_id WHERE c.claim_status='open' GROUP BY h.region) q ORDER BY region

raw_sql:
SELECT c.claim_id, COUNT(cp.payment_id) FILTER (WHERE cp.payment_status = 'posted') AS posted_payment_count
FROM claims AS c
LEFT JOIN claim_payments AS cp ON cp.claim_id = c.claim_id
GROUP BY c.claim_id
reference_a: SELECT c.claim_id,COUNT(p.payment_id) AS posted_payments FROM claims c LEFT JOIN claim_payments p ON p.claim_id=c.claim_id AND p.payment_status='posted' GROUP BY c.claim_id ORDER BY c.claim_id
reference_b: SELECT c.claim_id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claim_payments p WHERE p.claim_id=c.claim_id AND p.payment_status='posted') AS posted_payments FROM claims c ORDER BY c.claim_id

raw_sql:
SELECT c.claim_id, MAX(e.event_at) AS latest_event_at
FROM claims AS c
LEFT JOIN claim_events AS e ON e.claim_id = c.claim_id
GROUP BY c.claim_id
reference_a: SELECT DISTINCT ON (claim_id) claim_id,event_at AS latest_event_at FROM claim_events ORDER BY claim_id,event_at DESC,event_id DESC
reference_b: SELECT claim_id,event_at AS latest_event_at FROM (SELECT claim_id,event_at,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_id ORDER BY event_at DESC,event_id DESC) AS rn FROM claim_events) q WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY claim_id

raw_sql:
SELECT c.claim_id, (MAX(e.event_at)::date - c.opened_on) AS days_from_opening_to_latest_event
FROM claims AS c
JOIN claim_events AS e ON e.claim_id = c.claim_id
GROUP BY c.claim_id, c.opened_on
reference_a: SELECT c.claim_id,(MAX(e.event_at)::DATE-c.opened_on) AS days_to_latest_event FROM claims c JOIN claim_events e ON e.claim_id=c.claim_id GROUP BY c.claim_id,c.opened_on ORDER BY c.claim_id
reference_b: SELECT claim_id,(latest_event_at::DATE-opened_on) AS days_to_latest_event FROM (SELECT c.claim_id,c.opened_on,MAX(e.event_at) AS latest_event_at FROM claims c JOIN claim_events e ON e.claim_id=c.claim_id GROUP BY c.claim_id,c.opened_on) q ORDER BY claim_id

raw_sql: SELECT c.claim_id, COALESCE(SUM(cp.amount), 0) AS total_paid_amount FROM claims AS c LEFT JOIN claim_payments AS cp ON cp.claim_id = c.claim_id GROUP BY c.claim_id
reference_a: SELECT c.claim_id,COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) AS paid_amount FROM claims c LEFT JOIN claim_payments p ON p.claim_id=c.claim_id GROUP BY c.claim_id ORDER BY c.claim_id
reference_b: SELECT c.claim_id,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM claim_payments p WHERE p.claim_id=c.claim_id),0) AS paid_amount FROM claims c ORDER BY c.claim_id

raw_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.subscriber_id
FROM subscribers AS s
JOIN subscriptions AS sub
  ON sub.subscriber_id = s.subscriber_id
WHERE sub.status = 'active';
reference_a: SELECT DISTINCT subscriber_id FROM subscriptions WHERE status='active' ORDER BY subscriber_id
reference_b: SELECT s.subscriber_id FROM subscribers s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions x WHERE x.subscriber_id=s.subscriber_id AND x.status='active') ORDER BY s.subscriber_id

raw_sql:
SELECT market, COUNT(*) AS outage_count
FROM outages
WHERE started_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND started_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY market
reference_a: SELECT market,COUNT(outage_id) AS june_outages FROM outages WHERE started_at>=TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-01' AND started_at<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01' GROUP BY market ORDER BY market
reference_b: SELECT market,COUNT(*) AS june_outages FROM (SELECT market,outage_id FROM outages WHERE started_at>=TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-01' AND started_at<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01') q GROUP BY market ORDER BY market

raw_sql:
SELECT s.market, SUM(u.megabytes) AS total_june_megabytes
FROM usage_records AS u
JOIN subscribers AS s ON s.subscriber_id = u.subscriber_id
WHERE u.used_on >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND u.used_on < DATE '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY s.market
reference_a: SELECT s.market,SUM(u.megabytes) AS june_megabytes FROM subscribers s JOIN usage_records u ON u.subscriber_id=s.subscriber_id WHERE u.used_on>=DATE '2026-06-01' AND u.used_on<DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY s.market ORDER BY s.market
reference_b: SELECT market,june_megabytes FROM (SELECT s.market,SUM(u.megabytes) AS june_megabytes FROM usage_records u JOIN subscribers s ON s.subscriber_id=u.subscriber_id WHERE u.used_on>=DATE '2026-06-01' AND u.used_on<DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY s.market) q ORDER BY market

raw_sql:
SELECT s.subscriber_id, AVG(i.amount_due) AS average_invoice_amount
FROM subscribers AS s
LEFT JOIN invoices AS i
  ON i.subscriber_id = s.subscriber_id
GROUP BY s.subscriber_id
reference_a: SELECT s.subscriber_id,AVG(i.amount_due) AS average_invoice FROM subscribers s LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.subscriber_id=s.subscriber_id GROUP BY s.subscriber_id ORDER BY s.subscriber_id
reference_b: SELECT s.subscriber_id,(SELECT AVG(i.amount_due) FROM invoices i WHERE i.subscriber_id=s.subscriber_id) AS average_invoice FROM subscribers s ORDER BY s.subscriber_id

raw_sql:
SELECT i.invoice_id, i.amount_due - COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS amount_unpaid
FROM invoices AS i
LEFT JOIN payments AS p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
GROUP BY i.invoice_id, i.amount_due
reference_a: SELECT i.invoice_id,i.amount_due-COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) AS unpaid_amount FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id AND p.status='posted' GROUP BY i.invoice_id,i.amount_due ORDER BY i.invoice_id
reference_b: SELECT i.invoice_id,i.amount_due-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p WHERE p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id AND p.status='posted'),0) AS unpaid_amount FROM invoices i ORDER BY i.invoice_id

raw_sql:
SELECT s.seller_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.order_id IS NULL OR o.status <> 'completed') AS listing_count_no_completed_sale
FROM sellers AS s
JOIN listings AS l ON l.seller_id = s.seller_id
LEFT JOIN order_lines AS ol ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
GROUP BY s.seller_id
reference_a: SELECT s.seller_id,COUNT(l.listing_id) AS unsold_listings FROM sellers s LEFT JOIN listings l ON l.seller_id=s.seller_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=ol.order_id WHERE ol.listing_id=l.listing_id AND o.status='completed') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY s.seller_id
reference_b: SELECT s.seller_id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM listings l WHERE l.seller_id=s.seller_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=ol.order_id WHERE ol.listing_id=l.listing_id AND o.status='completed')) AS unsold_listings FROM sellers s ORDER BY s.seller_id

raw_sql:
SELECT s.seller_id, AVG(r.score) AS average_review_score
FROM sellers AS s
JOIN listings AS l ON l.seller_id = s.seller_id
JOIN reviews AS r ON r.listing_id = l.listing_id
GROUP BY s.seller_id
reference_a: SELECT s.seller_id,AVG(r.score) AS average_score FROM sellers s LEFT JOIN listings l ON l.seller_id=s.seller_id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.listing_id=l.listing_id GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY s.seller_id
reference_b: SELECT s.seller_id,(SELECT AVG(r.score) FROM listings l JOIN reviews r ON r.listing_id=l.listing_id WHERE l.seller_id=s.seller_id) AS average_score FROM sellers s ORDER BY s.seller_id

raw_sql:
SELECT l.listing_id, COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM listings AS l
LEFT JOIN order_lines AS ol ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id AND o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY l.listing_id
reference_a: SELECT l.listing_id,COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.status='completed'),0) AS sold_quantity FROM listings l LEFT JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.listing_id=l.listing_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=ol.order_id GROUP BY l.listing_id ORDER BY l.listing_id
reference_b: SELECT l.listing_id,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ol.quantity) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=ol.order_id WHERE ol.listing_id=l.listing_id AND o.status='completed'),0) AS sold_quantity FROM listings l ORDER BY l.listing_id

raw_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id, SUM(t.hours) FILTER (WHERE t.approved) AS total_hours
FROM employees AS e
LEFT JOIN timesheets AS t ON t.employee_id = e.employee_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id
reference_a: SELECT e.employee_id,COALESCE(SUM(t.hours) FILTER (WHERE t.approved),0) AS approved_hours FROM employees e LEFT JOIN timesheets t ON t.employee_id=e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY e.employee_id
reference_b: SELECT e.employee_id,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.hours) FROM timesheets t WHERE t.employee_id=e.employee_id AND t.approved),0) AS approved_hours FROM employees e ORDER BY e.employee_id

raw_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id
FROM employees AS e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM timesheets AS t
    WHERE t.employee_id = e.employee_id
      AND t.worked_on >= DATE '2026-06-01'
      AND t.worked_on < DATE '2026-07-01'
      AND t.approved = TRUE
);
reference_a: SELECT e.employee_id FROM employees e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM timesheets t WHERE t.employee_id=e.employee_id AND t.approved AND t.worked_on>=DATE '2026-06-01' AND t.worked_on<DATE '2026-07-01') ORDER BY e.employee_id
reference_b: SELECT e.employee_id FROM employees e LEFT JOIN timesheets t ON t.employee_id=e.employee_id AND t.approved AND t.worked_on>=DATE '2026-06-01' AND t.worked_on<DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY e.employee_id HAVING COUNT(t.timesheet_id)=0 ORDER BY e.employee_id

raw_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id, COALESCE(SUM(pa.amount), 0) AS total_payroll_adjustment_amount
FROM employees AS e
LEFT JOIN payroll_adjustments AS pa ON pa.employee_id = e.employee_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id
reference_a: SELECT e.employee_id,COALESCE(SUM(a.amount),0) AS adjustment_total FROM employees e LEFT JOIN payroll_adjustments a ON a.employee_id=e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY e.employee_id
reference_b: SELECT e.employee_id,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM payroll_adjustments a WHERE a.employee_id=e.employee_id),0) AS adjustment_total FROM employees e ORDER BY e.employee_id

raw_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id, MAX(tr.completed_on) AS latest_completed_training_date
FROM employees AS e
LEFT JOIN training_records AS tr ON tr.employee_id = e.employee_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id
reference_a: SELECT e.employee_id,MAX(t.completed_on) AS latest_training_on FROM employees e LEFT JOIN training_records t ON t.employee_id=e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY e.employee_id
reference_b: SELECT e.employee_id,(SELECT MAX(t.completed_on) FROM training_records t WHERE t.employee_id=e.employee_id) AS latest_training_on FROM employees e ORDER BY e.employee_id

raw_sql:
SELECT p.patient_id, COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount), 0) AS total_posted_payment_amount
FROM patients AS p
LEFT JOIN payments AS pay ON pay.patient_id = p.patient_id
GROUP BY p.patient_id
reference_a: SELECT p.patient_id,COALESCE(SUM(x.amount),0) AS posted_amount FROM patients p LEFT JOIN payments x ON x.patient_id=p.patient_id AND x.status='posted' GROUP BY p.patient_id ORDER BY p.patient_id
reference_b: SELECT p.patient_id,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(x.amount) FROM payments x WHERE x.patient_id=p.patient_id AND x.status='posted'),0) AS posted_amount FROM patients p ORDER BY p.patient_id

raw_sql:
SELECT p.patient_id, COUNT(e.encounter_id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'completed') AS completed_encounter_count
FROM patients AS p
LEFT JOIN encounters AS e ON e.patient_id = p.patient_id
GROUP BY p.patient_id
reference_a: SELECT p.patient_id,COUNT(e.encounter_id) AS completed_encounters FROM patients p LEFT JOIN encounters e ON e.patient_id=p.patient_id AND e.status='completed' GROUP BY p.patient_id ORDER BY p.patient_id
reference_b: SELECT p.patient_id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM encounters e WHERE e.patient_id=p.patient_id AND e.status='completed') AS completed_encounters FROM patients p ORDER BY p.patient_id

raw_sql:
SELECT patient_id, MAX(occurred_at)::date AS latest_encounter_date
FROM encounters
GROUP BY patient_id
reference_a: SELECT patient_id,MAX(occurred_at)::DATE AS latest_encounter_on FROM encounters GROUP BY patient_id ORDER BY patient_id
reference_b: SELECT p.patient_id,(SELECT MAX(e.occurred_at)::DATE FROM encounters e WHERE e.patient_id=p.patient_id) AS latest_encounter_on FROM patients p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM encounters e2 WHERE e2.patient_id=p.patient_id) ORDER BY p.patient_id

raw_sql:
SELECT procedure_code, COUNT(*) AS procedure_count
FROM procedures
WHERE performed_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND performed_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY procedure_code
reference_a: SELECT procedure_code,COUNT(procedure_id) AS june_procedures FROM procedures WHERE performed_at>=TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-01' AND performed_at<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01' GROUP BY procedure_code ORDER BY procedure_code
reference_b: SELECT procedure_code,COUNT(*) AS june_procedures FROM (SELECT procedure_code,procedure_id FROM procedures WHERE performed_at>=TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-01' AND performed_at<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01') q GROUP BY procedure_code ORDER BY procedure_code
